title: If you enjoy local flavors- don’t miss this!
text: Shane was a consummate historian of Catalan gastronomy, whose tour took us “one block off the beaten path” to hidden neighborhood gems for the classic flavors of Barcelona, as enjoyed by the locals. We ate delicious food, drank local wines and vermouth, and learned a tremendous amount about the history of Barcelona and Spain. Shane has a pleasant demeanor and a background as a student of culinary and general history, and of years preparing food and working in the restaurant industry.
